title: Smoky Dutch Rice Bowl
description: A hearty rice bowl dish featuring smoky flavors and creamy textures.

ingredients.name: Dutch-Style Sausages
ingredients.notes: Cooked to an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C)

instructions: Cook Smoky Rice according to package instructions.
Grill or pan-fry Dutch-Style Sausages until cooked through.
In a separate pan, heat Sesame Oil over medium heat.
Add Soy Sauce and cook for 1 minute.
Add Green Onions and cook for an additional minute.
Assemble the dish by placing cooked rice in a bowl, topping with sausages, slaw, and sauce.
Garnish with additional Green Onions if desired.
